target_invariant: A workflow may be executable only when every function role resolves to a system role, explicit manual queue, online-capable agent, capability match, or Telegram-reachable person; runtime dispatch may claim delivery only with target evidence in the workitem.dispatch receipt.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: workflow.validate reports missing or unresolvable roles as blocking readiness errors
acceptance_coverage.notes: Readiness receipts mark role failures as deployment, case-start, and release blockers.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: workflow.deploy refuses unresolved roles unless manual mode is explicit
acceptance_coverage.notes: Workflow-created skeleton RoleDefs are placeholders and do not count as explicit manual queues.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: dispatch receipts show actual target agent, person, system, or manual queue
acceptance_coverage.notes: Receipts distinguish queued agent/person/system delivery, manual queue fallback, and failed transport evidence for retry/dead-letter.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: operator UI can resolve role readiness errors before running
acceptance_coverage.notes: UI builds role.create/role.update payloads from stable role validation codes and reachable assignee options.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: assistant suggestions are validation-grounded and require operator confirmation
acceptance_coverage.notes: Assistant role_assignment suggestions become pending role.create/role.update confirmations only when the current workflow.validate receipt has a matching role error.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: named agent, capability match, person Telegram target, manual queue, and unresolved role failure are tested
acceptance_coverage.notes: Backend tests cover direct agent, capability, person directory, explicit manual queue, skeleton placeholder rejection, and failed dispatch target evidence.

direct_paths_kept.reason: An operator-created RoleDef with strategy=manual and no assignees is an explicit queue target, not a missing assignment.
System roles route to built-in system-agent execution and produce system target receipt details.
